artists.biography:
Wisdom of Crowds is the exciting new project featuring Bruce Soord from The Pineapple Thief with Jonas Renkse from Katatonia.
Originally written with Renkse’s voice in mind, Soord sought out the acclaimed Katatonia vocalist to complete the compositions and release the music to the masses. Despite the rigorous schedules of The Pineapple Thief and Katatonia, the two musicians were eventually able to connect.
Both artists are currently enjoying unparalleled success with their main bands.

perplexity.description:
All This Will Be Yours is Bruce Soord's second solo album, released in October 2019 through Kscope, six years after his self-titled debut. The record represents a deeply personal work, conceived during a transformative period in Soord's life—the birth of his third child coinciding with his observations of hardship in his hometown of Yeovil. This juxtaposition of joy and social deprivation shaped the album's thematic core, with Soord incorporating field recordings of everyday sounds—children playing, an elderly man singing, sirens—to ground the work in lived experience.

Musically, All This Will Be Yours showcases an acoustic and introspective approach to progressive rock, emphasizing sparse arrangements and emotional depth over complexity. The production, handled by Soord himself and mastered by fellow Pineapple Thief member Steve Kitch, creates a warm, immersive soundscape across nine tracks. Key compositions like the title track and "Time Does Not Exist" exemplify the album's contemplative character, blending wistful melancholy with moments of haunting intensity, while "The Solitary Path of a Convicted Man" demonstrates the sparse, atmospheric qualities that define the record.

Critical reception positioned the album as a cultured and affecting work within Soord's solo catalog. All This Will Be Yours built upon momentum from The Pineapple Thief's touring schedule and established Soord as a significant voice in solo progressive rock, preceding his later acclaimed album Luminescence in 2023. The deluxe edition, released as a hardback book containing three discs with acoustic reworkings, bonus tracks, and hi-resolution audio options, reflected the artist's commitment to presenting the work as a complete artistic statement.
